question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_loss_rate,
    stddev_loss_rate,
    avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate AS lower_bound,
    avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate AS upper_bound
  FROM stats
)
SELECT 
  b.avg_loss_rate,
  b.stddev_loss_rate,
  b.lower_bound,
  b.upper_bound,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < b.lower_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= b.lower_bound AND v."loss_rate_%" <= b.upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > b.upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_count
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, bounds b
GROUP BY b.avg_loss_rate, b.stddev_loss_rate, b.lower_bound, b.upper_bound
